method.coordinate_accuracy: PROJ operation accuracy is retained as transformation context; it is not a station-position or boundary-accuracy measurement. Points are never snapped.
method.boundaries: All matching polygons and operation-accuracy-near boundaries are retained; no single-HUC winner is imposed.

source.selection: Union of original upstream_huc12s plus focal HUCs; exact root-transmitted arrays
